name: Indigo Protocol
description: Synthetic asset protocol on Cardano where users lock ADA or whitelisted native tokens in a CDP to mint oracle-priced iAssets. Liquidations are absorbed by Liquity-style stability pools.
notes: iAsset list is from the official docs (docs.indigoprotocol.io iAssets page): iUSD, iBTC, iETH, plus iJPY and iEUR added by DAO governance. iSOL appears in secondary sources but not in the official docs page, so it is excluded. INDY is the fixed-supply governance token; ADA is the primary collateral.
